problems.problem: In the poster the bottle base (y=1152) sits ~280px below the only visible plane edge (the cloth top edge at ~y=870), and the cloth below that edge reads as a vertical draped skirt with hanging folds, not a receding tabletop. The enlarged contact crop [155,1012,493,1262] does show a real soft contact shade hugging the green base edge (offset_y 0 is correct, do not move it), but a shade alone cannot define a plane: with no visible surface under the base the bottle reads as hovering in front of the table skirt, unlike reference 4 where the can base, contact shadow and cloth top surface share one readable plane.
problems.root_cause: Background prompt produced a front-facing drape instead of a seated-eye-level tabletop band, so the declared horizon and the product base line disagree.
problems.repair_strategy: Regenerate the background so a shallow linen tabletop band spans the frame with its far edge just above the product base line, keeping the same oatmeal linen material and diffuse frontal light; keep shadow offset_y at 0.

problems.problem: The bottle occupies only x 235-413 (width ratio 0.165) at the left while the type column starts at x=648, leaving a ~235px dead gutter of empty grey between silhouette and text; the right two-thirds of the frame carry no visual event, so the 'vacant offered span' reads as unresolved emptiness rather than the intentional waiting place of the concept. References 3-5 all give the negative space an active role (cast shadow field, prop echo, splash), which this draft lacks.
problems.root_cause: Product scale sits at the minimum of the fresh-concept range and the type column is parked at mid-canvas instead of answering the vacant span from the right margin.
problems.repair_strategy: Enlarge the hero toward ~0.60 height ratio keeping center_x 324 and base 1152, and shift the type column into the right margin (x ~760-800) so bottle, horizon and type form one continuous left-to-right read.

problems.problem: Title bbox [648,605,961,657] and subtitle [653,720,817,736] leave a 63px optical gap between the 74px Baskerville title and the 24px tracked subtitle, so the two lines do not lock into one block; the subtitle's 6px tracking also makes it visually lighter than the title weight can support at this distance, and both lines float in flat grey with no alignment tie to the horizon or the bottle shoulder.
problems.root_cause: Subtitle y placed independently of title baseline; no shared alignment axis with the scene.
problems.repair_strategy: Tighten subtitle y to ~690 to form a single type block, and align the block's left edge to a consistent right-margin axis; keep serif family and exact copy.

problems.problem: The upper two-thirds is a flat warm-grey wall with a faint vertical gradient and no material, depth or light event; combined with the skirt-like drape below, the setting reads as a pasted cutout on a backdrop rather than the seated tabletop scene the concept declares. No studio equipment artifacts are present (good), but the environment itself is under-authored compared with reference 4's saturated cloth plane and deep field.
problems.root_cause: Background prompt describes horizon and backdrop but gives the renderer no tabletop surface band or light falloff to build depth.
problems.repair_strategy: Rewrite background.prompt to describe an empty oatmeal linen tabletop surface band with soft frontal daylight falloff and a calm warm grey rear wall, no equipment, no product words.

changes.value: Empty seamless warm grey studio wall behind a horizontal tabletop plane draped in neutral oatmeal linen, the linen surface visible as a shallow receding band whose soft far edge crosses the frame at lower-third height and whose cloth continues toward the viewer under diffuse frontal daylight, gentle wrap, calm soft shadows, no harsh highlights, no objects, no equipment

edges_clean.evidence: Silhouette edges against grey wall and linen show no halo, fringe or clipping; bbox [235,432,413,1152] stays fully inside the 1080x1440 canvas.

lighting_consistent.evidence: Scene illumination is soft diffuse frontal with gentle wrap, matching the cutout's vertical shoulder highlights and absence of rim light; no conflicting directional cast appears.
